description: Full-text search over every published press release (title and body), optionally within one category. Use it when the user names a company, product, person or topic. Returns short summaries with links; the full text is on the linked page. Limitation: English full-text matching, at most 10 results, no date filter.

category.description: Optional category slug or name from list_desks

query.description: Words to search for; quotes and minus work like a search engine

name: search_releases
title: Search press releases
